email_template.subject: Complete Your Profile - ${company_name} Career Website
email_template.content:
Dear ${candidate_name},

To be able to use the ${company_name} career website and apply for jobs, we need you to complete your profile, including your name in Arabic.


Please complete your profile by clicking on the Complete Your Profile button below, and make sure the information you provide is accurate and complete.

We wish you all the best!


Complete Your Profile


Best Regards,
${company_name}
